description: Interactive-usability probe suite (2026-11-19). Local-only rig, quotas disabled. Axes: multi-turn context, steering/followup, routing evidence, failure-path surfacing, plan-vs-direct delineation. Frozen prompts: do not reword to make routing pass.

tasks.prompt: Create a file named counter.txt in the repository root containing exactly the number 3 on a single line. Use file_write with direct:true.

turns.message: Read counter.txt, add 4 to the number in it, and write the result back to counter.txt (file_write with direct:true). Then reply with the new number.

tasks.prompt: Create a file named result.txt in the repository root containing exactly the number 7 on a single line. Use file_write with direct:true so the file lands on disk immediately.

turns.message: Create a file named result2.txt in the repository root containing exactly the number 7 on a single line. Use file_write with direct:true so result2.txt lands on disk immediately. This replaces the earlier result.txt - after this, the only result file on disk must be result2.txt. Do not start new work beyond writing result2.txt.

tasks.prompt: Fetch the page at http://127.0.0.1:9/usability-fixture.html and save its body text to a file named fetched.txt in the repository root.
Read the file definitely_missing_12345.txt in the repository root and tell me its exact contents. If you cannot read it, tell me plainly that it does not exist.

Make a plan for adding a greetings module to this project: it should say hello in three languages, have tests, and a README section. Do not implement anything yet, just produce the plan for my approval.
Write a file named direct.txt containing the word ok. Do this directly now, no planning needed. Use file_write with direct:true.
